changelog.1_2_0.1: Skin Storage Cloud: folders, favorites, reorder mode and drag-to-folder with confirmation.
changelog.1_2_0.2: New Options page with this changelog, language switch (English / Thai) and Streamer Mode.
changelog.1_2_0.3: Streamer Mode blurs file paths and links; hold ALT to peek.
changelog.1_2_0.4: Saving a skin that is already stored asks whether to overwrite it, skip it or keep both. Identical skins are now numbered in order of saving.
changelog.1_2_0.5: The 3D preview always shows a standing, full-body skin, whatever your game mode or pose.
changelog.1_2_0.6: New toast notifications: clearer, sized to fit and colour coded.
changelog.1_2_0.7: Redesigned import and skin type screens, with a back arrow instead of buttons.
changelog.1_2_0.8: Hold Shift over a long skin name to read it in full.
changelog.1_1_0.1: Skin Cloud Storage and the interactive 3D preview were added.

changelog.1_2_1.1: The main menu (Devathip Interface) now has import, Skin Storage Cloud and Settings buttons, plus a Close button. Esc closes it.
changelog.1_2_1.2: The target-folder banner only shows when you import from a folder in Skin Storage Cloud.
changelog.1_2_1.3: Fixed Browse: JPG files and large images now load safely instead of crashing or disconnecting the game (max 4096x4096).
changelog.1_2_1.4: The 3D preview is sized to fit and stays inside its box when rotated.
changelog.1_2_1.5: Skin Storage: remove a skin from a custom folder back to All, fixed imports landing in a deleted folder, and the mouse wheel only scrolls the skin list.
changelog.1_2_1.6: Hold Shift over the file path to read it in full. Toasts are smaller and lighter.
type.pick.title: Save to which folder?
type.pick.subtitle: Choose where this skin will be stored.
changelog.1_2_2.1: Icons on the main menu buttons.
changelog.1_2_2.2: Skin Storage: inside a custom folder you can keep adding skins with the new button and move them out with the amber button. Main folders have full-size buttons.
changelog.1_2_2.3: Save to Storage now asks which folder the skin should go to, then opens the Storage on it.
changelog.1_2_2.4: Mouse wheel over a skin preview zooms the 3D model. Shift + wheel over the file path scrolls it.
changelog.1_2_2.5: The 3D preview stays visible behind dialogs, the Streamer Mode warning has a 'don't show again' box, and the what's-new popup only appears in the main menu.
